formula: w=sqrt(usd)*(0.4+hit)*(sybil?0.5:1); sy=sum w[above]/sum w; hr=sum w*hit/sum w; sig=(2sy-1)(2hr-1); logit p = logit(clamp(pm,1e-6)) + 1.4*(n/(n+6))*sig; ci=max(2,round(164*sqrt(p(1-p)/(4n+10)))); edge=round(100*(p-pm))
note: round() is round half up like JavaScript Math.round. Building when fewer than 3 wallets or total weight is zero.

cases.name: hit rate one half gives no signal
hit rate below one half (anti skill)
hit rate out of range is clamped
negative usd is floored at zero
